interface.signature: def canConvertString(s: str, t: str, k: int) -> bool

preconditions.description: Length of s is between 1 and 10^5.
Length of t is between 1 and 10^5.
All characters in s are lowercase English letters.
All characters in t are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (len(s) == len(t) and all((ord(t[i]) - ord(s[i])) % 26 <= k for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: Return true if s can be converted to t in no more than k moves, otherwise return false.
